design:
Tier 1, with a hazard named: this is the operator's launch path; a broken change means AgentWeave does not open. Rollback: revert the commit; the change is CLI-only plus a packaged page and two WAVs.
D1. `_open_app_window_native(url_or_start, warm)` takes either a URL or a start-up callable returning (url | None, failure text). It creates the window with html=splash, background ink, and passes the work to webview.start(func=...), which pywebview runs on its own thread.
D2. The worker waits for the page's `loaded` event, starts the sound, runs the start-up, waits out the minimum, asks the page `awSplashLeave()` (ms until the thread is next fully drawn plus the fade), sleeps that, then `load_url`.
D3. The detached cold path moves its body (scaffold, migrations, spawn, health, resolve URL) into `_hub_spawn_detached(...)`, which returns the URL or a failure, unchanged in what it prints; the native window calls it from the worker. Without pywebview, the old order stays.
D4. Sound is a WAV made offline by scripts/make_opening_sound.py (Karplus-Strong, seeded, the thread lab's settings: key D, brightness 0.45, ring 0.55, room 0.18), notes timed to the corners of the W under the splash's own easing. Played with winsound.SND_ASYNC (stdlib) or afplay/paplay in a subprocess; failures are silent.
problem: Today `agentweave` starts the Hub and shows nothing until it answers /health (up to 60 s, cli.py:1353); only then is the window created (cli.py:1145). The operator asked: 'When we run agentweave I want before opening also to give it a buffer time to show the thread animation before opening' and 'A sound plays with the animation of the thread when opening agentweave.'

requirements.rationale: The buffer is the time the operator already waits; showing it is the point.
requirements.statement: When `agentweave` opens the native app window, it MUST create the window showing the splash before it runs migrations or waits for the Hub, and MUST run that start-up work off the window's thread.

requirements.rationale: Operator's pick in the thread lab (https://claude.ai/artifact/GniK2BGBQJzh2ouG3boTpN).
requirements.statement: The splash MUST draw the loop with the shuttle pass (the madder thread drawing the W from its left end with a light glint at its head), then show the name and the tagline 'Run your AI factory in the open.'; while the Hub has not answered after the intro it MUST keep the thread weaving through, and it MUST stand still, fully drawn, under reduced motion.

requirements.rationale: Operator: 'give it a buffer time to show the thread animation before opening'; warm open short version chosen 2026-10-23.
requirements.statement: The window MUST switch to the app only when the launch URL is known and the splash has shown for at least 2.0 s on a cold start or 1.2 s when the Hub was already running, and only at a moment the thread is fully drawn.

requirements.rationale: Operator: 'A sound plays with the animation of the thread when opening agentweave.' The window's browser engine blocks sound before a click, so the CLI plays it.
requirements.statement: The CLI MUST play the opening sound when the splash page has loaded, the full phrase on a cold start and the short one on a warm start, without blocking the window, and MUST play nothing when AGENTWEAVE_SOUND is 0 or no player exists.

requirements.rationale: Today a failed start prints and returns 1; the window must not hang on a splash.
requirements.statement: If the Hub fails to start, the splash MUST say so in words naming the terminal for details, then the window MUST close and the command MUST return 1.

in_scope: A packaged splash page (agentweave/assets/splash.html): self-contained, no network, the shuttle-pass intro, then the weave-through loop while waiting, still under reduced motion
The native app window created first on the splash, with the Hub's start-up (migrations, spawn, health, launch URL) run off the UI thread, then the window navigated to the app
A minimum splash time: 2.0 s on a cold start, 1.2 s when the Hub is already running (a short intro)

An opening sound packaged as WAV (agentweave/assets/opening.wav, opening-short.wav), generated reproducibly by scripts/make_opening_sound.py from the thread lab's instrument; played by the CLI with the stdlib (winsound on Windows; afplay/paplay where present) when the splash page has loaded
A start-up failure shown on the splash in words, then the window closes and the CLI returns 1 as today
non_goals: Notification sounds inside the app (the next change)
The browser fallback window (_open_app_window) and the foreground --no-detach path keep today's behaviour
A sound setting in the app UI (the env var is the opt-out until the notification change adds preferences)

summary: Launching AgentWeave opens its window at once on a splash: the madder thread draws the W with a bright glint running ahead of it (the 'shuttle pass', operator's pick in the thread lab), the name and tagline appear, and a plucked-thread phrase plays in time with it. The window switches to the app when the Hub is ready and the splash has shown for its minimum (about 2 s cold, 1.2 s when the Hub was already running); a slow Hub keeps the thread weaving until it answers.
